notes.title: 📢 Citizens, attention! Our engineers have prepared Patch #2
notes.content:
[p][b]Deserter: Prologue[/b] continues to evolve under your watchful feedback and our tireless effort. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Korean language localization. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved character voiceovers. Added a new voice for the elite soldier.	[/p][/*][*][p]New items can now be found in houses every day. [/p][/*][*][p]NPCs react faster when they spot the protagonist: they chase or attack more aggressively and coordinate better in groups. [/p][/*][*][p]NPCs now interact with windows: they can look and shoot through them, and even climb through to continue the chase.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem where difficulty levels may not have applied properly - so if you found the game too hard on Easy or vice versa, make sure to give it another go!
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Inventory UI improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now sell all useless junk at once when starting a trade. [/p][/*][*][p]Tool icons now display which objects they can be used to unlock. [/p][/*][*][p]When inspecting certain consumables, you’ll see which of John’s parameters they affect (hunger, fatigue, health).
[/p][/*][/list][p]Together we strengthen the cause - your feedback is the fuel of progress. Now is the perfect time to try [i]Deserter: Prologue[/i], share your thoughts, and maybe even leave a review.[/p]
